top.line: How WizPress, the AI operating system for newsrooms, and our open-source trust stack could work together.
top.para: Production plus proof; a thirty-day pilot.

in-short.line: WizPress produces; we add trust; stages map to axes; six ways; a pilot; ours is open source.

wizpress.line: Built in Faro, led by a former journalist: monitor, capture, draft, publish, the journalist deciding.

us.line: A provenance profile: origin, research, claims, review, external, and a ladder to on the record.
us.para: On vaults, keys, QR codes and behaviour policies.

together.line: Inbox policies, evidence vaults, provenance records, signatures, signed responses, a local news network.
together.para: WizPress keeps the journalist in charge; this shows it.

pilot.line: One regional newsroom, one section, thirty days: keys, vaults, provenance, signatures, responses, measured.

bring.line: WizPress brings product, customers and newsroom experience; we bring the open trust stack and a test bed.
bring.para: Both: AI that makes journalism more trustworthy.
